notes: Undo Auto Spread puts your days and route order back the way they were before the last Auto Spread, Re-Spread All, Re-Optimize or Optimize Route.

Re-Optimize pulls later Flexible stops forward onto an earlier nearby day that has room, never later, and puts each changed day in its shortest driving order. Optimize Route reorders one day on the Route.
Days By City lets you pick the weekdays each city gets for Auto Spread and Re-Optimize.
The Route shows blowouts and tests in one list with a map, numbered pins and an All, Winterize or Tests filter.
Cards, buttons and toolbars are more compact across the app, with icon tiles that fit a phone screen. Edit Address changes an existing service address.
Blowout Reminders settings, queue and send history now live on Profile. Unsent rows read Not Texted Yet, and test accounts or customers already on the route are left out of Send Blowout Texts.
